name: Xiamen University Malaysia (XMUM)
status_detail: Operational · opened in 2016 in Sunsuria City, Sepang
summary: A branch campus of China's Xiamen University, a Project 985 and 211 university, opened in 2016 on a 150-acre urban campus at Sunsuria City near KLIA. It is accredited by both the Malaysian and Chinese governments.

scale.label: Accreditation
scale.value: Governments of Malaysia and China; Malaysia's Ministry of Higher Education and China's Ministry of Education

why_it_matters: A top-tier Chinese university campus inside the KLIA corridor ties the Klang Valley directly into China-Malaysia education and talent flows, and it was the anchor tenant that kick-started the whole Sunsuria City township in Sepang.
questions_to_follow: How does enrolment trend as China-Malaysia education ties deepen?
Does XMUM's presence pull more Chinese investment into the Sepang/KLIA corridor?
location_precision: XMUM campus, Sunsuria City, Sepang. Coordinates from the university's Wikipedia page.

history.event: Malaysia's Minister of Higher Education officially invites Xiamen University to set up a campus in Malaysia.
Registration approved by the Ministry of Higher Education of Malaysia.
XMUM officially opens at Sunsuria City, Sepang.
